tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos kyi byung tshul mdo tsam dang bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len 'gos lugs gtsang ma yid 'phrog lha'i rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ngag gi dbang phyug mkhas kun dga' ba'i dpal/ /bsod nams yangs pa'i chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur/ /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan yid bzhin dbang gi tog /skye dgu'i dpal yon bzang po gang der 'dud/ /mgon de'i legs byas gsung gi gsang ba che/ /chos kyi byung tshul bdud rtsi'i gtam skyes dang / /bskyed rdzogs rim pa'i bsgom tshul legs par bshad/ /yid 'phrog lha yi rol mo 'dir brjod bya/ /de la 'dir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid yig 'di sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen par gsang 'dus kyi chos skor rnams rgyas par phul dus mkhan chen nyid kyis gsung rtsom gnang ba la/ slar gsal byed kyi mchan bu du ma btab ste/ sa skya pa a nanda rang nyid kyi rtsom dpe'i khrod du bcug pa yin/ gang bshad par bya ba'i chos ni gangs ljongs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par sprul pa dpal ldan sa skya pa rnams kyi yab chos bde kye gsang gsum du grags pa'i nang nas da lam 'dir gsang ba 'dus pa 'chad pa skabs su babs/ 'di 'chad par byed pa la don gsum ste/ chos 'di'i byung tshul mdo tsam rnam par bshad pa/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i sgom don rnam par bshad pa/ skabs don rim lnga bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni 'o skol gyi ston pa thub pa'i dbang pos gnas gang du gang zag gang la thog mar gsungs/ de nas tshul ji ltar dar rgyas su byung ba yin snyam na/ bshad par bya ste/ 'di la gsum/ thog mar byung tshul/ 'phags yul du dar tshul/ bod yul du dar tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ au ḍi ya na'i gnas su rgyal po ind+ra bhu ti bzhugs pas nam mkha' la ston pa'i nyan thos rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba mthong nas ya mtshan te/

'di tsho ci yin zhes 'khor rnams la dris pas/ da lta 'dzam bu'i gling na rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i sras don thams cad grub pa sangs rgyas pa'i mtshan shākya thub pa bya ba gdul bya rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bzhugs pa de'i nyan thos yin zhus pas/ rgyal po chos kyi bag chags sad de/ ston pa la dad pa bla na med pa skyes/ de'i rkyen gyis ston pa 'khor bcas mnyan yod na bzhugs pa mngon sum du mthong ste/ sang gi nyin par bdag gi 'dir gdugs tshod la 'byon du gsol zhes zhus pas/ rdzu 'phrul gyis sang der byon/ ston pa la rgyal pos 'dod yon la longs spyod bzhin du 'tshang rgya ba'i chos gcig zhu byas pas/ gsang sngags kyi snod du gzigs nas ston pas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i skur bzhengs te de nyid kyi dkyil 'khor du rgyal po la dbang bskur bas rgyal pos dbang dus nyid du grub rgyal pos phyis spros bcas kyi spyod pa mdzad pa skad ni 'khor rnams grol bar bya ba'i phyir tshul bstan pa yin/ pa chen po thob/ rgyal po la gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud dang bshad rgyud rnams gsungs te phyag na rdo rje la gtad/ der rgyal pos rgyud rnams gser gyi shog bu la bai ḍūrya zhun mas bris te de dag bzhugs pa'i khang bu yang byas so/ /de nas rgyal po'i 'khor yul khams de na gnas pa thams cad grub pa thob nas phyis yul de mtshor gyur/ phyag na rdo rjes mtshor gnas pa'i klu rnams la dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ lam bstan pas klu las gyur pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma mang du byung ngo / /gnyis pa 'phags yul du dar ba'i tshul ni/ 'phags yul du rgyal po bi su kalpa'i legs pa'i tog ces bya ba/ rmi lam du khyod u rgyan du song zhig dang / skye ba 'dir rdo rje 'dzin pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes rmis pas mnal sad nas rim gyis u rgyan du byon/ klu las gyur pa'i rnal 'byor ma dang mjal/

des gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang bskur lam bstan/ rgyud rnams byin/ de nas rgyud rnams spyan drangs nas 'phags yul du byon nas rgya gar lho phyogs su dar bar mdzad de/ bi su kalpa la mkhan po sgra gcan 'dzin bzang pos gsang ba 'dus pa zhus/ des lam bsgoms pas grub pa thob pa'i mtshan sa ra ha zhes grags/ mi yul du lo brgya phrag bco brgyad bzhugs/ de la slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis gsan/ slob dpon des gsang 'dus la smin byed kyi cho ga nyi shu pa/ bskyed rim la sgrub thabs mdor byas/ de rgyud kyi lung dang sbyar ba mdo bsre/ rdzogs rim la rim lnga'i gzhung mdzad/ de'i slob ma slob dpon arya de bas lam mtha' dag dang rdzogs rim kyi spyi khog spyod pa gsum dang bcas pa ston pa la spyod bsdus sgron me/ sems dben gyi skabs la mkho ba sems kyi sgrib sbyong / sgyu lus kyi skabs la mkho ba bdag byin gyis rlabs pa'i rim pa/ 'od gsal gyi skabs su mkho ba mngon par byang chub pa mdzad/ shākya bshes gnyen gyis kha cig spyod bsdus la 'grel pa mdzad zer/ gzhung mdzad pa cher mi grag 'on kyang rim pa gnyis pa'i srid pa'i gzeb las rnam grol 'gyur zhes pa'i rjes thogs/ shes rab ngo bo nyid 'di ni zhes pa nas/ rim pa gnyis pa rdzogs kyi bar shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad/ klu sgrub kyi dngos slob slob dpon klu byang gis smin byed rdul tshon la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nyi shu pa/ bskyed rim la sbyang gzhi sbyong byed kyi rim pa la sogs don gyi gnad phul phyin ston pa rnam gzhag rim pa le'u bzhi'i bdag nyid can/ sems dben dang 'brel ba las mtha' rnam 'byed/ rim pa lnga spyi la phan pa la rim lnga khong bsdu'i gzhung mdzad/ slob dpon sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen gyis ras bris la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zung 'jug gsal ba mdzad/

klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa skong ba'i slob ma zla grags kyis gsang 'dus kyi rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel chen sgron ma gsal ba mdzad/ de'i slob ma slob pa'i rdo rje de la nag po spyod pas gsan/ de'i slob ma la dri med blo gros dang / rgyal sras sa 'dres pa gnyis/ snga ma las ye shes snying po/ des mar pa la brgyud pa'i tshul 'og tu 'chad do/ /yang rdo rje 'chang dngos kyis dga' ldan gyi lha'i bu sa bcu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen la gdams/ des 'dzam bu'i gling du byon nas bram ze chen po sa ra ha dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub gnyis la gdams/ klu sgrub kyis ma tam̐ gi pa la/ des ti lo pa la/ des na ro pa la gdams so/ /sa 'dres pa la slob ma lnga ste/ mngon shes can/ btsun mo can/ shanti pa/ dpal sbas/ mar me mdzad bzang po rnams byung / dang po'i mtshan ni birya bha dra/ bod skad du brtson 'grus bzang po/ 'dis mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus kyi gtor chog yod/ gnyis pa'i mtshan ni de wa a ka ra shanti bod skad du lha'i 'byung gnas zhi ba zer/ shanti pas rgyud kyi 'grel pa snyim pa'i me tog mdzad/ 'di 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs pa'i gzhung du byed/ dpal sbas sogs gzhan gnyis nas brgyud pa bod du cher ma byung ba 'dra/ 'on kyang rang lugs kyi brgyud yig 'ga' na dbang gi brgyud pa la dhi pam̐ ka ra'i rjes su 'gos bgrangs pa yang 'dug pas kha tshon gcod dka'/ mar me mdzad bzang po ni ye shes zhabs lugs pa'i brgyud pa la 'byung ba de dang gcig mi gcig brtag dgos/ mngon shes can gyi slob ma la rdo rje gdan gyi nag po pa/ mtshan dngos shanta bha dra shrī/ bod skad du zhi ba bzang po dpal bya ba yin te/ 'gos kyi stong thun chen mo'i dbur/ rgyal ba'i chos la mnga' brnyes bdag gi bla ma bzang po dpal/ zhes 'byung ngo / /'dis rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog mdzad/ mngon shes can gyi gtor chog dang nag po pa'i rdor sems kyi mchod chog gnyis sgrub thabs mdor byas kyi yan lag tu mkho ba'i gzhung yin no/

/gnyis pa bod yul du dar ba'i tshul la/ mar lugs dar tshul dang / 'gos lugs dar tshul gnyis/ dang po ni mnga' bdag mar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros kyis 'phags yul du bla ma mang du bsten/ chos bka' bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan/ khyad par 'dus pa gsan tshul ni/ nā ro pa la 'dus pa'i dbang dang / rim lnga'i khrid/ rgyud rkyang gi bshad pa hril gyis dril ba tsam gsan/ rgyas par ni nub gu la kṣe tra'i gtsug lag khang na bzhugs pa'i dpal ye shes snying po las 'dus pa'i dbang / rgyud gdams pa 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i bka' mtha' dag gsan te bod du tshur ston dbang gi rdo rje la gdams/ de nas mkhon gad pa kirti/ byang kha ba bsod nams rin chen/ mi nyag la thur ba tshul khrims skyabs/ rgya mkhar thang dpe ba 'phags pa skyabs/ gser sdings pa gzhon nu 'od/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ bu ston rin po che/ khyung lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ de la rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos 'dus pa mar lugs kyi skor phal cher gsan zhing / mar lugs 'ga' zhig ni grub chen buddha shrī la yang gsan par snang / 'phags pa skyabs man chad mar pa dang 'gos kyi brgyud pa gnyis ldan du bzhugs la/ gzhon du 'od gsang 'dus la mkhas shing zhal pho yang che/ lugs gnyis kyi nang nas mar lugs la thugs rtsis che/ 'dis mdzad pa'i yig cha'i rnam grangs ni/ bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis gdan thog gcig tu bsgom pa/ lam rtags dang 'brel ba'i man ngag don lnga ma dang don bzhi ma/ rim lnga gdan thog gcig tu bsgom pa'i man ngag 'khor lo can dang 'khor lo med pa/ srog rtsol la brten nas gtum mo bsgom pa rim lnga dang sbyar ba/ rim lnga sems dpa' gsum brtsegs kyi gdams pa/ 'khor ba 'byung ldog la brten nas ma rig pa rtsa nas gcod pa'i gdams ngag skye 'chi gnyis la brten nas 'pho ba grong 'jug gis le lo can 'chi khar 'tshang rgya ba'i man ngag

mnyam gzhag sgyu ma rmi lam sgyu ma bar do sgyu ma gsum gyi man ngag sku gsum gyi 'pho ba'i man ngag btsan thabs su 'pho ba'i man ngag chags can 'og sgo la brten nas bde ba bsgom pa'i man ngag bsre ba drug gi man ngag rdo rje sems dpa'i seb lam sdig po che btsan thabs su 'tshang rgya ba'i man ngag mgrin par rmi lam la brten nas sgyu ma btsan thabs su bzung ba'i man ngag snying khar mi shigs pa'i thig le la brten nas ma rig pa rtsad nas gcod pa'i man ngag rim lnga cig char ba'i man ngag gsang ba thugs kyi rim lnga'i man ngag da lta nyid nas 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi bzhugs tshul gtan la dbab pa/ pha rgyud yang snying / ma rgyud yang snying rnams te chos tshan nyer lnga 'di rnams man ngag zab mo ni yin/ nā ro chos drug sogs kyi 'dres shor ram yang zer/ gang ltar klu sgrub nas ar de sogs la brgyud pa'i gdams pa ni min/ klu sgrub nas ma tam̐ ki pa la brgyud pa ni yin pa srid/ tsam yod/ lo rgyus ma gtogs 'di dag bla ma'i man ngag gi gnad kyi khrid yin pas man ngag gnad khrid dam nag khrid du grags/ gu ge paṇḍi ta'i gsan yig na man ngag gnad khrid bshad 'dug nag khrid kyi don ni man ngag gnad khrid la sgra zur 'chol bas nag khrid dam/ yang na bskyed rdzogs gdan thog gcig ma sogs man ngag 'thor bu ba de dag so sor yi ger bkod de nag 'gros kyi tshul du phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa la nag khrid du grags/ bu ston gyi khrid yig sogs na'ang nag khrid ces pa bshad/ smar khrid ni/ nyams len smar 'don du gril nas bshad pa'i spros pa skyung bas sam/ yang na nā ro pa las gsan pa'i grub thob nyams brgyud kyi khrid la smar khrid du grags pa 'dra snyam du sems/ de'i phyir na khyung lhas pa'i drung du/ shar chen pas rim lnga'i sgom khrid gsan zhes bshad pas sgom khrid dang smar khrid ming gi rnam grangs yin par sems/

des na rim lnga smar khrid ces pa mar lugs kyi kha skad yin zhing / 'gos lugs la de'i grags tshod mi 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa 'gos lugs dar tshul ni/ 'gos lo tsā ba bsod nams rtse mos 'phags yul du phebs nas spyir bla ma bdun cu rtsa gnyis tsam bsten/ de'i nang nas sngar bshad pa'i bla ma btsun mo can/ mngon shes can/ nag po pa dang gsum la gsang 'dus mthil phyin pa gsan pas 'gos kyi gsang 'dus gsan pa'i bla ma gsum bya ba yin/ gsang 'dus kyi bod 'grel 'ga' zhig dang / kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung rgyun las byung ba'i gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i bskyed rim gyi bshad pa las/ rgyal po sprin gyi shugs can la yang gsang 'dus gsan par bshad de de ltar na bla ma bzhi'o/ /de nas 'gos kyis bod du phebs nas sgom sgrub dang 'chad nyan zung 'brel du mdzad/ slob ma yang rgyud kyi ka ba btsugs pa bzhi/ man ngag gi gdung theg pa bzhi/ las tshogs dang 'phrin las mkhas pa lcam dang dral ma gshibs pa lta bu mang bar byung / ka chen bzhi ni rlan grags dbang / mang ra ba seng ge rgyal mtshan/ sum ston ye 'bar/ mi nyag dharmā tsant+ra'o/ /gdung bzhi ni rngog dge ser/ dbus pa dbang gsum/ lho pa rdo rje snying po/ gnyal pa chos kyi shog dang bzhi'o/ /'gos lo chen po des sgron gsal la 'gyur bcos cung zad mdzad/ de la sgron gsal dbyar khral ma zer/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud lo chen rin bzang gis bsgyur pa la bcos ma mdzad/ rgyud don mtha' dag mngon rtogs kyi rim par bsdebs nas brjod bya rgya che bar ston pa stong thun chen mo dang / 'chad thabs rgyan bdun gyi rnam bzhag sogs ston pa'i stong thun chung 'di yod par stong thun chen mor bshad/ ba dang / rtsa rgyud kyi tshig 'grel sgron gsal gzhir bzhag pa la bla ma rnam gsum gyi bshad srol thun mong ba dang / nang gsel mi 'dra ba sogs ma 'dres par rtsa rgyud kyi steng du mchan bkod pa la rgyud kyi mchan chen du grags pa rnams mdzad/

gzhan bla ma gsum kyi gdams pa yi ger bkod pa la 'gos kyi shog ril gsum du grags pa yang yod do/ /shog ril gsum ka rim lnga'i khrid 'chad byed kyi gzhung rtsa ba lta bur 'dug pas 'gos kyis rim lnga'i khrid bla ma gsum ka la gsan par thag chod la/ ngor chen gyis mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs na/ bslab gsum rnam dag brtson 'grus bzang po'i zhabs/ /zhes mngon shes can dngos su smras pa 'di yang gcig kho na ston pa ma yin gyi/ mngon shes can gyis mtshon nas gzhan gnyis kyang nyid kyi brgyud par shes dgos so/ /'gos nas brgyud pa 'phel ba la rdog lugs dang / sa lugs gnyis su byung ba las/ dang po ni/ mang ra ba khams nas byon te bla ma la zhabs tog dang mos gus ches pas 'phags skor gyi gdams ngag ma lus par gsan cing mkhyen/ 'jad du bzhugs yod pa la khams nas rdog ye shes seng ge chos zhu ba la byon/ sku nye bar dgongs nas rdog la dges po mdzad de dbang rgyud gdams pa ma lus pa gnang / rdog shes rab che bas bla mas gsungs pa'i chos rnams mi zin pa mi srid/ 'dis stong thun 'bring po rim lnga'i sgron ma bya ba mdzad/ des rang gi sras nyi ma seng ge la chos thams cad gnang / 'dis dzambha la 'grub pas 'byor ba che/ 'phags lugs kyi gzhung rnams la sa bcad/ ṭikka/ khyad par rgyud kyi stong thun chung ba bya ba dang / sgron gsal gyi 'grel bshad sgron chung du grags pa rnams mdzad/ rdog gi yig cha rnams sgo rum dpe khang na bzhugs pa la ngor chen gyis gzigs pas nyi ma seng ge'i rnams legs pa 'dug gsungs/ 'di la sras arya de wa byung yang gzhon nu la khams su bskyal bas yab la chos rnams gsan ma thub/ phyis yar byon nas nyi la seng ge'i slob ma shangs kyi rlan rtsad tsha nyi ma lcam la yab chos thams cad rdzogs par gsan/ sa skyar byon nas chos rje sa paṇa gyi zhabs la yang gtugs nas sa skya pa'i chos mang po gsan/

sa skyar 'dus pa la sogs pa'i 'chad nyan mdzad/ sa paṇa gyi slob ma zhang bya ru bar grags pa de 'di yin gsungs/ 'dis gsang 'dus la dkyil chog dang rgyud 'grel la sogs pa mdzad/ gu ge paṇḍi ta'i gsan yig las rdog gis mdzad pa'i rim lnga'i khrid yig yod par gsungs/ des na 'gos lugs gtsang mar 'gro bas rang lugs kyi khrid kyi rgyab brten du btsal bar bya'o/ /ar de la rtag pa rin grags/ gtsang smra seng / mi nyag rdo rje grags gsum gyis gsan/ yang rdog nyi ma seng ge dang / rlan rtsad tsha gnyis ka la sne mo gzhu phug ston shes rab grags kyis gsan/ de la yang mi nyag rdo rje grags dang / gtsang smra seng gnyis kyis zhus/ de gnyis ka la lce ston mdo sde se dgyes zhus/ yang rlan rtsad tsha la thang dpe mkhan po 'phags pa skyabs kyis zhus/ de la gser sdings pa gzhon nu 'od kyis zhus/ ar de'i slob ma rtag pa rin grags dang / lce stod mdo sde seng ge dang / gser sdings pa gzhon nu 'od gsum ka la kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyis gsan/ de nas ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi bar mar lugs kyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin rim can du yin te/ srad pa kun blo'i gsung las/ mang ra seng rgyal rdog chen ye shes seng / /nyi seng nyi ma lcam dang arya de/ /rin grags smra seng rdor grags mdo sde seng / /'bum skyabs 'phags pa skyabs dang gzhon nu 'od/ /kun 'dus chos sku 'od zer 'phags pa 'od/ /bu ston sras mchog gzhon nu bsod nams las/ /dpal ldan bla ma ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal/ /de las kun mkhyen bzang pos lan gsum gsan/ /zhes bshad do/ /kun mkhyen 'phags 'od kyis rim lnga'i khrid yig chung ngu zhig don ri grags chen gyis bskul ba'i ngor mdzad/ yang ngo sprod yu mo khug bya ba sde snod dang rgyud sde'i chos thams cad rim lngar 'dus tshul gyi bshad pa zhib mo zhig mdzad/ 'dis rim lnga'i khrid dmigs la phan pa zhig mi 'dug

yu mo khug bya ba 'dir rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun zin bris las/ yu mo khug gi don/ mnga' ris pa/ 'ba' dug byung byung glen pa la zer ba'i dpe sbyar nas snyan ngag sdeb sbyor sogs med par blun gtam yu mo khug tu ngo sprad ces par snang zhing / bar skabs su thugs rtsis shin tu che bar mdzad mod/ gsal le/ stong nge / dkyil le/ mer re/ mtsho 'dra ba/ zhes sogs gsungs pa bzhin du 'dug pas 'di zhes bya ba'i ngo sprad rgyu dang / go rgyu yang chung bar 'dug pas gal che rgyu med gsungs/ ngo sprod yi ge de nyid rang las/ 'dir da res lung sbyor dang bshad pa'i na ya dor te/ yu mo khug nyams thog nas ngo sprad par bya'o/ /zhes 'byung ba yin no/ /yang sbyor drug pa la grags pa'i kha skad cig yin nam zer/ bla ma 'di sbyor drug dang 'dris ches pas khrid yig chung ngu de na yang sbyor drug gi dmigs pa gcig tsam bris yod par grag 'phags 'od kyis zha lu ru phebs/ brgyud pa'i lugs srol so so'i phyag len thams cad 'dus pa'i dbang bka' rgyas pa gcig gnang / de nas rim lnga'i khrid dang rgyud kyi bshad bka' sogs mtha' dag gnang / bu ston rin po ches bstan pa'i khur bzhes te 'chad nyan rtsal du bton pas gsang 'dus kyi bstan pa mi nub pa'i srog shing lta bur gyur/ yig cha yang gsang 'dus kyi chos 'byung / rgyud kyi bshad thabs gsang ba'i sgo 'byed/ sgron gsal gyi 'grel bshad mtha' drug rab gsal/ sgrub thabs dkyil chog rim lnga'i smar khrid nor bu rin po che'i za ma tog la sogs pa mang du mdzad/ bu ston gyi khrid 'di dben gsum 'gos lugs gtso che/ sgyu ma dang 'od gsal mar lugs gtso che/ zung 'jug bsdus se ba la lugs gnyis ka dang mthun pa yod par rang lugs kyi mkhas pa rnams bzhed/ bu ston rang gi dgongs pa mar lugs su bzhed rgyu yin pa 'dra ste/

khrid yig gi dbu phyogs na rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i don bshad pa'i rgyud bzhi'am brgyad kyi dgongs pa legs par phye zhing / 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyi don mngon du gyur nas dgongs pa legs par bkral te ti lo pa dang nā ro pa la sogs pa mkhas grub rnams kyi thugs dam du legs par bstan nas zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa'i man ngag rgyud sde zab mo thams cad kyi sgo 'byed pa'i lde mig lam rim pa lnga'i smar khrid ces sogs gsungs 'dug pas so/ /des na bu ston gyi khrid mar lugs gtso che ba dang / rgyud rgyud 'grel gzhung 'grel dang bcas pa'i bshad bka' 'gos nas rdog pa la brgyud pa'i lugs gtso che zhing / dbang bka' 'phags 'od la gsan pa'i bka' bab so so'i lugs kun 'dus zer ba de yin na bsres rgyud kyi dbang bkar byed dgos/ yang chos 'byung gi yi ge 'ga' zhig las/ klu byang gi dkyil chog nyi shu pa'i lugs kyi cho ga la bla ma 'phags pa'i dkyil chog dang / bu ston gyi 'di gnyis bgrangs 'dug pa ltar na sa skya pa'i dbang bka' gsar ma'i lugs su 'gro ba yin no/ /gnyis pa sa lugs ni/ rje 'gos kyis mkhon dkon mchog rgyal po la/ des skyu ra a skyabs la/ des sa chen la gnang / yang 'gos kyi slob ma rgyud kyi ka ba tshugs pa dbus pa dge ser gyis bla ma gnam kha 'ub pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan la 'dus pa'i dbang rgyud gdams pa mtha' dag gnang / kha'u pa la sgrub thabs bstan pa'i nor rdzas su grags pa yod/ des sa chen la dbang rgyud sgrub thabs mtha' dag gnang / des kha'u pa rdo rje bdud 'joms la/ des rje btsun rin po che la gnang / rang lugs kyi lo rgyus 'ga' rer sa chen yab sras gsum rim par byas nas rdo rje bdud 'joms ma bgrang ba yang yod/ rje btsun nas/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa chen po/ brag phug pa blo brtan/

chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims pa/ grub chen buddha shrī/ de la chos rje rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsang 'dus kyi dbang bka' dang / 'gos lugs kyi rim lnga'i khrid dang / mar lugs kyi skor 'ga' re yang gsan/ des na rgyud rgyud 'grel sogs kyi bshad pa la shar chen pa bka' drin che/ 'gos kyi khrid la buddha ba bka' drin che ba yin/ yang sa paṇa gyis mar pa nas 'khon gad pa kirti sogs la brgyud pa'i rim lnga stan thog gcig ma la sogs pa rnams gsan te/ rab dbyer chos gsan tshul gyi skabs su/ rim lnga stan thog gcig ma dang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar rtogs nus so/ /yang kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī bod du phebs/ de la sa paṇa gyis mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa gsan zhing / khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo dang gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang rgyud sgrub thabs gdams pa kun cha tshang bar gsan/ de'i dus su lo pan khyad par can kha che paṇa chen dang bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gnyis kyis klu byang gi dkyil chog nyi shu pa dang / sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog zung 'jug gsal ba gnyis gsar du bsgyur/ de phyin chad nas sngar gyi dbang la dbang bka' rnying pa dang / kha che pan chen nas klu byang gi dkyil chog nyi shu pa gsar du bsgyur pa de'i lugs kyi dbang bka' gsar ma'i tha snyad bzhag go /de ltar na bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyis gsang ba 'dus pa 'gos lugs/ mar lugs/ kha che ba'i lugs gsum ka gsan te 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab cing dar rgyas su mdzad/ dbang bka' gsar ma de'i nye brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ klu sgrub/ 'phags pa lha/ ma tam̐ gi pa/ sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen/ shrī bi ka ta de wa/ kha che paṇa chen/ sa paṇa/ 'od zer shākya/ kha'u pa dar ma shes rab/ rin chen dpal/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ spru lung kun smon/ don ri grags pa dpal/ 'phags 'od yon rgyam/ bu ston rin po che/

khyung lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / yang na sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal nas ngor chen gyi bar dbang bka' rnying ma'i brgyud pa dang 'dra/ ngor chen nas brgyud pa 'phel tshul ni/ dbang bka'i brgyud pa la ngor chen/ mus chen/ kun mkhyen/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rin/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang chen po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ dpal sa skya pa mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag la gnang / yang ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub nas/ mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ de'i dngos slob rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po bsod nams lhun grub kyi drung du yang dbang bka' legs par thob/ khrid dang lung phal che ba'i brgyud pa ni/ kun mkhyen yan dbang dang 'dra ba las/ kun mkhyen gyis 'jam dbyangs sangs rin dang / paṇa chen kong ston gnyis la/ de gnyis kas bdag chen rin po che ngag gi dbang phyug la/ des mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ des mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des dpal sa skya pa bdag chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ chos kyi spyan ldan 'jam mgon dam pa 'di nyid kyi zhabs drung du bdag gis gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod pa'i dbang bka' rgyas par thob rjes su 'gos lugs gtsang ma'i rim lnga'i khrid ngor chen gyi zung 'jug gsal sgron dang / mang mkhar pa brgyud 'dzin blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi mus chen sems dpa' chen po'i gsung la zin bris kyi yi ge'i steng nas rgyas par mtha' chod dang bcas 'gos lugs dang mar lugs so sor mi 'dra ba'i shan 'byed dang /

dmigs pa'i gnad rnams 'gos lugs gtsang ma dpyis phyin pa 'dom par mdzad pa blo yul du nges pa dang bcas thob/ de'i skabs su lung rgyun gyi skor la gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa yan dang / de'i 'grel chen zla ba grags pa'i sgron gsal/ rgyud phyi mar grags pa le'u bco brgyad pa/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs mdor byas/ mdo bsre/ 'phags pa lha'i spyod bsdus sgron me/ klu byang gi rnam gzhag rim pa sogs rgya gzhung khag che rags rnams dang / 'gos kyi shog ril gsum la sogs pa dang / bu ston rin po che'i bshad thabs gsang ba'i sgo 'byed/ 'grel bshad mtha' drug rab gsal/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi rgya mtsho skor dgu/ ngor chen dang kun mkhyen thun mong ba'i khrid yig zung 'jug gsal sgron/ kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung rgyun las byung ba'i gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i rnam bshad/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi dbang gi mtshams sbyor mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i gzhan phan skor gsum/ bdag chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs 'di nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus kyi chos 'byung chen mo la sogs pa gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi chos skor rnams phal cher tshang bar thob pas lugs 'di la cung zad dad pa thob cing / zab mo'i don rnams la yang blo gros kyi mig bu gsal bar 'gyur du re smon dang bcas pa lags so/ /sa skya'i 'jam mgon zhal gyi padmo las/ /legs 'ongs gsang chen chos kyi gtam brgya phrag /'chi med bdud rtsi'i ro brgya dang 'grogs te/ /blo gros rna ba'i yol gor 'di na sim/ /de ltar na dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi chos skor ji ltar byung ba'i tshul gsang chen chos kyi sgo 'byed ces bya ba ste rim par phye ba dang po'o// ༈ //dhīḥyig 'od du 'bar ba lha yi lha/ /gangs khrod che dgu'i gtsug gis bsten pa la/

/sa skya pa zhes grags pa'i rgyal rnga che/ /'gro 'di'i mgon du g.yo med brtan bzhugs gsol/ /gang gi gsung gi gsang ba chos kyi sgo/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong 'phags blo'i spyod yul che/ /byis blos gzhal bya min yang don gyi bcud/ /bskyed rim lam gyi legs bshad phreng ba spel/ /gnyis pa bskyed pa'i rim pa'i bsgom don bshad pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes lam gyi yan lag go /dang po la thun mong ba'i sngon 'gro dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'o/ /dang po ni/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed la/ de nas pha rgyud kyi rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyis thun mtshams kyi nyes ltung sbyangs nas rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ khams gsum spyod pa las grol mkha' dang mnyam 'gyur sogs kyi phyag bya mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro bas mchod yon dang nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ a ru pa badzra sogs 'dod yon lngas kyang mchod/ de nas gur nas byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa byas pa'i rjes su rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung nas tshogs zhing gshegs su gsol te/ de ni yul dag pa la brten pa'i bsod nams tshogs bsag yin/ de nas tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni yul ma dag pa la brten pa'i tshogs bsag go /de nas chos thams cad skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid du bsam la oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod pa ni ye shes tshogs bsag go /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro srung 'khor bsgom pa la bdag bsrung ba/ gnas bsrung ba rnal 'byor bsrung ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ mdor byas las/ zhe sdang rdo rje'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /zhes pas bstan/ de yang stong pa'i ngang las dang por pad zla'i steng du rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yum bcas bsgom/

snyoms 'jug gi rkyen gyis mkha' nang du mi bskyod pa bskyed/ de thugs kar drangs/ de las de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus/ snying kha'i mi bskyod pa la zhugs pas sngar gyi zla ba nyi gdan du gyur pa'i steng du rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa yab rkyang du bskyed pa yin te/ mdo bsrer/ dang por rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog dkar po bdag nyid ji lta ba bzhin du mos par bya'o/ /de nas le'u dang po las/ ye shes sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gsungs pa'i tshul gyis mi bskyod pa bskyed nas rjes su zhugs pas zhe sdang rdo rjer bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bdag nyid ji lta ba bzhin du zhes pa'i 'bru non la nag po pas/ sgrub pa po bdag nyid gdong gcig lag gnyis pa yin pa bzhin du skabs 'di'i rdo rje 'chang zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bshad cing / mdor byas kyi 'grel mdzad thub pa dpal gyis kyang de bzhin du bshad gsungs/ gnyis pa gnas bsrung ba ni/ gnas bsrung ba ni brtsam par bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ 'di la gnyis te/ sngar yod kyi bgegs tshar bcad pa dang / phyis mi 'byung ba bya ba'i phyir bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ 'dul byed kyi khro bo spro ba/ gdul bya'i bgegs 'gug pa/ 'dul tshul phur bu btab pa'o/ /dang po ni mdor byas las/ 'bar ba'i 'od phreng 'jigs par byed/ /nyi ma la gnas hūm̐ las byung / /g.yon brkyang ba yi rnam pas gnas/ /khro bo bcu ni spro bar bya/ /phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor cha ru ni/ /rim pa bzhin du bsam par bya/ /zhes dang / mdo bsre las/ hūm̐ ring po las khro bo'i rgyal po bcu phyung la zhes pas bstan/ de yang rang zhe sdang rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ ring po de las khro bo bcu dpag tu med pa 'jig rten gyi khams khyab par spros/

bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus/ mang po gcig la gcig thim pa rtsa ba'i khro bo bcur gyur pa rang zhe sdang rdo rjer gsal ba'i phyogs mtshams steng 'og gi nam mkhar pad nyi'i gdan la 'khod par bsam la/ shar du gshin rje nag po zhes sogs bskyed chog dkyus bzhin/ khro bo bcu'i mdun du hūm̐ ring po las grub pa'i khron pa gting ring ba 'brub khung gi rnam pa can re yang bsam/ gnyis pa bgegs 'gugs pa ni/ 'og gi gnod mdzes las gnod mdzes gnyis pa chad/ gtso bo'i mdun du 'ongs nas bdag las ci bgyi ba bka' stsal du gsol/ zhes sogs dkyus bzhin la/ bka' nod pa'i gnod mdzes de phyag tu lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ mtshon cha thogs pa dpag tu med par gyur nas phyogs bcur 'phros/ ngo bo phyogs de dang de na gnas pa'i bgegs kyi gtso bo yin pa la/ rnam pa brgya byin la sogs pa phyogs skyong de dang de'i rnam par byas nas bkug ste khron par skyur ba'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin/ gsum pa ni de nas byang gi khro bo bgegs mthar rgyud las bgegs mthar byed 'di la bdud rtsi 'khyil par bshad pas mngon rtogs rnams las byang gi bdud rtsi 'khyil pa las rdo rje phur bu spro bar gsungs pa yin/ byed las rdo rje phur bu stod khro bo la/ smad mdung rtse gcig pa'i dbyibs can me 'bar ba bcu spros bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor zug oṃ gha gha ta ya la sogs pa brjod/ yang gnod mdzes kyi phyag tu/ rdo rje tho ba byung nas phur ba'i rtse nas brdungs pas bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar du phug pas lus ngag yid gsum g.yo ba dang / rgyu ba dang / rnam rtog med par 'od gsal stong nyid du thim ste/ gnod mdzes rnams kyang 'og gi sprul gzhi'i gnod mdzes la thim par bsgom mo/ /'dir bgegs kyi gtso bo bkug pa 'di rnams phyogs skyong rang rgyud pa yin nam snyam na/

'di la kun mkhyen bla mas/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul pa phyogs skyong gi tshul bzung ba dang / phyogs skyong rang rgyud pa dang / bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong gi rnam par bkug pa dang gsum las/ 'dir phyi ma yin par gsungs pa ni gnad kyi don no/ /de ltar na gsang 'dus dang / gshin rje gshed sogs kyi sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / phyi rol gtor ma'i skabs rnams su ni phyogs skyong rang rgyud pa spyan drangs nas mchod gtor 'bul zhing 'phrin las 'chol ba yin par shes par bya'o/ /babs bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong gi rnam par 'gug pa 'di la rgyu mtshan zhig yod snang bas de btsal bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa phyis mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ me 'od spros nas bgegs kyi 'khor tshar bcad pa dang / me tshur 'dus te khro bo bcu'i phyi rol tu me ris dang rdo rje'i rwa gur sogs bsgom pa dkyus bzhin no/ / 'dir ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis 'bru gsum gyi grangs ji tsam bzla'i gsal kha ma gsungs kyang / gung ru'i rnam bshad las bcu gcig bzla bar bshad/ de yang khro bo bcu gcig la dmigs nas 'bru gsum re re bzla ba yin/ de ltar me ris ni mdor byas nas bshad/ ra gur sogs ni mdo bsre las/ de nas 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i sngags kyis rdo rje'i ra ba bsam pa dang / hūm̐ mdzad kyi rdo rje rwa ba yi ge hūm̐ gis sa'i cha rdo rje rang bzhin du bsam zhing / zhes gsungs pas bstan to/ /gsum pa rnal 'byor bsrung ba ni mdo bsre las/ yi ge gsum gyi go cha la sogs pa bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas bstan/ bsgom don ni dkyus bzhin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum ste/ dang por sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin/ las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no/ /dang po la rten bskyed pa dang / brten pa bskyed pa la gnyis kyi dang po la gsum ste/

ye shes kyi sa'i cha bskyed pa/ rdo rje'i sa'i cha bskyed pa/ lha'i gnas bskyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dngos po med la bsgom pa med/ /ces sogs brjod la/ sgom po dang / bsgom pa dang / bsgom bya gang du yang mngon par zhen pa dang bral ba'i stong nyid kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /de skad du mdor byas las/ tshigs bcad 'di yis rgyu mi rgyu'i/ /bdag nyid can rnams stong par bsgom/ /cho ga'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /ye shes sa gzhir byin gyis brlab/ /ces gsungs so/ /ye shes kyi sa'i don ni/ a bha yas zla 'od du/ ye shes kyi sa ste bde ba chen po'i sa zhes bshad pas/ de ltar na ye shes ni yul can bde ba chen po'o/ /de'i sa'am gnas ni yul stong ba nyid de/ de bsgom pa la ye shes kyi sa bskyed pa zhes bzhag go /de yang snod bcud gong gi srung 'khor dang bcas pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid du thim par bsgom pa ste/ spyir bsgom tshul la snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom pa dang / snang med du bsgom pa gnyis las/ 'dir snang ba ye mi dmigs par spros bral 'ba' zhig bsgom pa'i skabs yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ mdor byas las nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas pa/ /hūm̐ gnyis sa bon yam̐ las byung / /zhes pa nas/ dkyil 'khor bzhi po yang dag bsdu/ /rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i dkyil 'khor la/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don stong pa'i ngang las dang por chos kyi 'byung gnas dkar po gru gsum pa zhig bsgom/ de'i nang du sa bon yam̐ dang ram̐ sogs las byung ba'i 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje gnyis res mtshan pa bsgom ste/ de'i tshe rlung gi me sbar des chu bskol/ des sa'i dkyil 'khor zhu nas thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa las sna tshogs rdo rje rgya khyon shin tu che ba zhig grub par bsgom pa'o/ /'dis ni bskal pa chags yong ba'i skabs kyi rlung la sogs pa sbyong bar bzhed do/

/gsum pa lha'i gnas bskyed pa ni/ mdor byas las/ der ni bhrum̐ las byung ba yis/ /zhes pa nas/ rnga yab sogs kyis brgyan par bya/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / mdo bsrer/ yi ge bhrum̐ gyi gnas bsgom ste/ /zhes bya bas skad cig gis gzhal yas khang pa bsam la zhes pas gzhal yas khang bskyed pa bstan to/ de nas dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar sna tshogs rdo rje'i stegs bu'i steng du gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bsgom pa'o/ /de'i rnam gzhag ni/ sdom las/ 'og gzhi logs dang steng thog dang / /sgo dang rta babs lnga yis bsdus/ /zhes pa ltar don tshan lnga'i sgo nas rtogs par bya ba dkyil 'khor spyi'i rnam gzhag dang mthun pas 'dir ma bkod la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par cung zad ni/ gzhal yas khang gi rtsig nang du lha snam phyogs mdog can rgyar cha chen re/ dpangs su cha phran re byas pa ni khro bo dang sems dpa' brgyad kyi gnas/ de'i nang du lha snam rgya dang mdog gong ltar la dpangs cha chen rer byas pa ni rdo rje ma bzhi'i gnas/ de'i nang du dkyil 'khor dbus ma gru bzhi pa shar nub kyi rgyar cha chen bzhi/ dpang cha chen gcig pa/ de'i steng du gar bu zlum po rgya dpang de dang mnyam pa'i sdeng rdo rje rtse gsum pa 'od phreng dang bcas pas bskor ba rigs bzhi yum bzhi'i gnas de'i dbus su dpangs cha chen gcig gis stegs bu bya ba ni gtso bo yab yum gyi gnas so/ /gdan 'god pa ni dbus su gtso bo'i gdan padma dang nyi ma sogs dkyus bzhin dang / gtso bo'i dbu'i steng gi nam mkhar steng gi khro bo'i gdan pad nyi dang / gtso bo'i 'og gi padma de la yu ba cha phran lngar byas pa'i rtsa bar 'og gi khro bo'i gdan bsgom ste/ gtso bo'i gdan gyi pad 'dab kyi 'og tu khro bo 'byung ba yin no/ /'di 'dra'i rigs can dkyil 'khor gzhan la yang yod do/ /yang rta babs kyi skabs su mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa yang lugs 'dir snam bu bcu gcig ma bzhed do/

/gzhal yas khang bskyed pa 'dis ri rab gling bzhi la sogs pa mtshon zhing / snod kyi 'jig rten sbyong bar byed do/ /gnyis pa brten pa lha bskyed pa la gsum/ lhag mos kyi ting nge 'dzin/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin/ rjes chags kyi ting nge 'dzin no/ /dang po la lhag mos dngos dang / de'i mdzad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bdag nyid skad cig gis dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du zhes sogs dkyus nas 'byung ba bzhin lha thams cad skad cig gis bskyed la zhal phyag rim gyis gsal 'debs pa yin no/ /snga ma kha cig zhal phyag sogs gsal mi 'debs par skad cig gis lam lam byung ba la lhag mos su 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de mdor byas las/ bdag nyid phyag rgyar ldan pa ni/ /zhal gsum phyag drug lta bu la/ /ind+ra ni la'i mdog 'dra ba/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su bsgom par bya/ /zhes dang / zhal gsum phyag drug lta bur ni/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su bsam/ /zhes gsungs pa zhal phyag gsal 'debs dgos par bstan to/ /skad cig gi bskyed pa dang lhag par mos pas bskyed pa don gcig mi gcig brtag par bya'o/ /lhag mos 'dis ni snod chags pa'i rjes su bskal pa dang po'i mi rnams byung ba brdzus skyes yin pas brdzus skyes rnams sbyong bar byed do/ /gnyis pa de'i mdzad pa ni/ lhag mos kyi lha so so'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad bkug nas dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi nas zhugs te byang chub kyi sems kyi dbang bskur ba sogs mngon rtogs bzhin no/ /'di ni dus 'khor gyi cho gar sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po'i dbang sbyin pa dang babs gcig par 'dug go /dpal gyi rgyal mtshan pas/ sems can thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi nas 'jug pa 'di la rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pa zhes bya ste/ dper na tshogs pa mang po gtsug lag khang du 'jug pa lta bu'o/ /zhes bshad/ spyir ni rdo rje sems dpa'i 'jug pa dang /

thogs pa med pa'i 'jug pa/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'jug pa/ rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pa dang bzhi yod par ko sa la'i rgyan du bshad zer/ ngor chen gyi dkyil chog ye shes rgya mtsho las/ rdul tshon 'bri ba na rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas thig gi 'og nas zhugs par mos la dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su phyin te zhes dang / dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa na rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas dkyil 'khor gyi rtsig pa'i 'og nas 'dzul te dbus kyi mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las zhes gsungs pas/ lhag mos kyi mdzad pa 'dir yang sems can thams cad sgo bzhi'i sgo glegs kyi 'og nas zhugs par mos te dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams mthong bas sgrib pa dag par bsgom rgyu yin pa 'dra'o/ /lhag mos kyi mdzad pa 'di mdor byas/ mdo bsre/ rnam gzhag rim pa gsum du mi 'byung bas sgrub thabs snga ma phal cher du ma gsungs kyang / sgron gsal gyis zil gnon rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyi skabs su gsungs pa de 'dir kha bskangs pa yin te/ 'gos kyi stong thun chen mor yang 'di gsungs so/ /mdzad pa 'di bskal ba dang po'i brdzus skyes de rnams las bsog pa mtshon zhing de sbyong byed yin no/ /gnyis pa rnal 'byor bzhi ni/ rnal 'byor dang / rjes su rnal 'byor dang / shin tu rnal 'byor dang / rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /dang po ni/ mngon byang dang po de bzhin nyid la byang chub pa stong pa dang / gnyis pa zla ba byang chub pa snang ba gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin la rnal 'byor zhes bya ste/ mdo bsrer/ da ni rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa brtsam par bya ste/ zhes pa nas/ ye shes tsam la snyoms 'jug pa/ /rnal 'byor yin par shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de la gnyis/ de bzhin nyid la byang chub pa dang / zla ba la byang chub pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ rags pa'i lhag mos lus la bsdu ba/ phra ba'i lhag mos 'od gsal du bsdu ba/

de sngags kyis brtan par bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ lhag mos kyi mdzad pa'i rjes thogs su rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa 'khor gyi lha thams cad spyan drangs te rnam snang spyi bor thim pa nas bzung / gnod mdzes rkang mthil gnyis su thim par bsams te/ de la yang spyan drangs pa'i gnod mdzes cha gnyis su gyur nas thim pa yin no/ /'di dag ni mdor byas las/ rang gi lus la de rnams gzhug /ces gsungs pa'i don no/ /de'i tshe na rnam pa spyi bo la sogs pa sbyang gzhi de dang de sbyong byed rnam snang la sogs pa'i lha de dang de'i ngo bor bsgom pa tsam yin zhing / lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du bsgom pa ni ma yin no/ /'khor gyi lha la mi bskyod pa med pa snying khar bstim rgyu med la/ 'on kyang zin bris 'ga' zhig na de'i tshe snying khar mi bskyod pa skad cig gis bskyed nas de nyid du thim par bsam dgos zer ba ni rtog bzo yin no/ /gnyis pa phra ba'i lhag mos bsdu ba ni de ltar lus la thim pa'i rnam snang spyan ma gzugs rdo rje ma/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dang sa snying gnyis/ khro bo gshin rje mthar byed dang mi g.yo ba gnyis/ 'od gsal du thim pa nas bzung 'jam dbyangs ma gtogs gzhan rnams dkyus bzhin gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba dang gnod mdzes gnyis/ reg bya rdo rje ma dang gsum 'jam dpal la thim/ de yang gtso bo la thim/ gtso bo yang 'od gsal du thim par bsams te/ 'dir lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can 'od gsal du thim rgyu ni med pas lha de dang de'i ngo bor gyur pa'i sbyang gzhi dang de 'od gsal stong nyid du thim pa la lha de thim zhes btags pa yin no/ /lhag mos bsdu ba 'di ni bskal pa dang po'i brdzus skyes de rnams 'chi ba mtshon zhing 'chi srid sbyong byed yin no/ /gsum pa sngags kyis brtan par bya ba ni/ de ltar rten gyi lha thams cad 'od gsal du thim pa'i stong pa de'i ngang du cung zhig gzhag la de brtan byed kyi tshul du sngags brjod pa yin te mdor byas las/

brtan par bya ba'i don du ni/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa zla ba la byang chub pa ni/ sngar bskyed pa'i gzhal yas khang de'i dbus kyi nam mkhar hūm̐ sngon po las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du oṃ dkar po las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du āḥdamar po las padma dmar po 'dab brgyad/ de'i steng du yi ge gsum steng nas steng du brtsegs par bsgom/ de nas yi ge gsum dang padma yas nas rim bzhin zla ba la thim/ nyi ma mas nas yar thim te thams cad 'dus pas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang bar bsam/ de las 'od 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad bsdus nas zla ba la thim pas chos thams cad rang sems 'od gsal ba'i bdag nyid du bsgom la oṃ dharmā dha tu sogs brjod pas brtan par byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa rjes su rnal 'byor ni/ rnal 'byor dang po'i rjes de ma thag tu byas pa'i rnal 'byor te/ de yang mdor byas las/ de la sbyor ba dmigs nas kyang / /zhes pa nas/ dang po'i mgon po bsam nas kyang zhes pa'i bar dang / mdo bsrer/ de nas le'u bcu gcig pa las/ rdo rje gsum yig sngags kyi mchog /ces pa nas/ rdo rje 'chang chen po 'di ji lta ba bzhin du bsgom pa ni rjes su rnal 'byor ro zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ 'di la gsum/ sa bon la byang chub pa/ phyag mtshan la byang chub pa/ sku rdzogs pa la byang chub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge gsum chu las chu bur rdol ba'i tshul gyis byung bar bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa ni yi ge de las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu nas rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ yi ge gsum la thim pas rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la yi ge gsum gyis mtshan par bsgoms nas oṃ badzra sogs brjod pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ de yongs su gyur pa las dang po'i mgon po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mtshan dpes spras pa'i longs spyod rdzogs sku pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa bskyed do/

/mngon byang gi rim pa de dag la sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprad na gzhal yas khang gi nang gi nyi ma ni pha'i rdo rje rgyas pa/ steng gi padma ni ma'i padma/ bar gyi zla ba ni pha ma gnyis rjes su chags pa mtshon pas de dag sbyong bar byed/ steng gi yi ge gsum ni bar do'i lus ngag yid gsum mtshon pas de sbyong bar byed/ 'og gi nyi ma dang steng gi yi ge gsum la sogs pa zla ba la zhugs nas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas rdzogs par gnas pa ni pha ma'i khams dkar dmar dang / bar do'i rnam shes gsum 'dres te mngal gyi mer mer po'i gnas skabs de sbyong bar byed do/ /zla ba las 'od 'phros nas snod bcud thams cad tshur bsdus nas thim pas chos thams cad 'od gsal ba'i bdag nyid du bsgom pa 'di ni bar do'i rnam shes khu khrag gis bcings te rlung rang gnas su rgyu ba'i stobs kyis sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran te skye ba 'di dang 'di blangs so bya ba 'di dang 'di byas so zhes pa la sogs pa ji snyed cig gsal bar dran pa de dang chos mthun zhing de sbyong bar byed do/ /de nas mngon byang gsum pa zla ba'i steng du yi ge gsum thol gyis byung ba ni mngal gyi gnas skabs ltar ltar po de dang chos mthun pas de sbyong bar byed de/ gnas skabs der lus kyi rtsa yig rnams kyang grub pa yin no/ /mngon byang bzhi pa phyag mtshan la sa bon gyis mtshan pa ni gor gor po dang chos mthun zhing de sbyong bar byed/ der ma zad mngal gyi gnas skabs 'phrang 'gyur du gnas pa yang sbyong bar byed de/ de'i tshe lus rdo rje'i rwa ltar 'bur lnga dang ldan pa'i phyir de dang yang chos mthun no/ /mngon byang lnga pa dang po'i mgon po bskyed pa ni mngal gyi gnas skabs yan lag dod pa dang chos mtshungs pas de sbyong bar byed do/ /gsum pa shin tu rnal 'byor ni/ dang po'i mgon po'i thugs khar mi bskyod pa bskyed pa de spros/

slar 'dus nas bdag nyid la zhugs pas bdag nyid sprul sku rdor sems sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug par bsgyur ba la lus dkyil 'god par mdzad pa 'di yin te/ mdor byas las/ shin tu sbyor ba yang dag rtsom/ /mi bskyod pa ni rjes zhugs pas/ /zhes pa nas/ phung po la sogs cho ga bzhin/ /sku yi dkyil 'khor rdzogs gyur nas/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /mdo bsre/ rnam gzhag rim pa/ sgron gsal dang gsum las/ mngon byang lngas bskyed pa'i dang po'i mgon po la lus dkyil bkod/ mdo bsre sogs dang mthun par ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis dang po'i mgon po la bkod pa'i lus dkyil gyi yig chung logs na mdzad pa yod/ de'i rkyen gyis de nyid sprul sku rdor sems zhal gsum phyag drug par bsgyur bar bshad pas mdor byas dang bshad tshul tha dad pa'o/ /'di 'dra'i rigs can klu sgrub dang klu byang gi dkyil chog nyi shu pa bshad tshul mi mthun pa yang rten gzhi'i rgyud tha dad pa'i dbang gis sam rgyud gcig kyang gdul bya'i bsam pa tha dad pa dang mthun par bshad tshul mi 'dra ba yin pas de dag la 'gal ba'i khur yod par mkhas pa dag gis rtog mi rigs sam snyam mo/ /mdor byas kyi lugs de ltar dang po'i mgon po'i thugs kha nas mi bskyod pa spro bas ni mngal gyi gnas skabs kyi lus de yan lag rnams dod cing rdzogs pa na mngal de nyid mi gtsang ba dang dog pa dang gcer ba sogs su mthong nas btsas 'dod kyis rnam par rtog pa du ma skyes pa de sbyang gzhir byas nas sbyong zhing de dag mtshon nus pa yin no/ /mi bskyod pa phyir spros pa de slar rang nyid la rjes su zhugs pa ni sbyong byed/ de'i sbyang gzhi ni mngal nas btsa' 'dod yod kyang zla ba dang zhag gi grangs ma thim zhing las kyi rlung gis mgo mjug ma bsgyur ba de srid du phyir btsas mi yong ba de yin te/ sbyong byed de dang sbyang gzhi de chos mthun no/

/de nas sprul sku rdor sems su gyur pa ni sbyong byed/ de'i sbyang gzhi ni zla ba dang zhag gi grangs tshang zhing las kyi rlung gis mgo mjug ldog ste ma'i chos 'byung gi phyir 'thon pa la btsas pa zhes pa'i tha snyad byed pa de yin te/ sbyong byed de dang sbyang gzhi de chos mthun no/ /de nas sprul sku rdor sems de la lus dkyil bkod pa ni sbyong byed/ de'i sbyang gzhi ni btsas tshar nas phung khams skye mched yan lag dang nying lag rnams rim gyis je rags je rags su song ba de yin te/ gnyen po sbyong byed de dang sbyang gzhi de chos mthun no/ /lus dkyil bsgom pa 'di shin tu'am lhag par rnal 'byor yin pas shin tu dang lhag par don gcig pa mkhas pa 'ga' zhig bzhed do/ /'on kyang mdor byas kyi lugs la shin tu rnal 'byor gyi gtso bo ni sprul sku rdor sems bskyed pa 'di yin zhing / de'i rjes la lus dkyil bsgom pa yin no/ /bshad tshul gnyis pa mdo bsre sogs kyi lugs la mngal gyi gnas skabs su zla ba phyed dang gnyis rdzogs nas lus kyi dngos po cha shas rnams tshang bar dod cing de nyid snga ma snga ma las je rags je rags su song ba de sbyang gzhir byas nas dang po'i mgon po'i rten la lus dkyil 'god pa ni sbyong byed/ de nas zla ba dang zhag gi grangs sogs tshang zhing las kyi rlung gis mgo mjug bsgyur te phyir btsas nas pha ma la sogs pa'i mig gi yul du gyur pa de sbyang gzhir byas nas sbyong byed sprul sku rdor sems su bsgom pa 'di yin te/ rnam gzhag rim pa las/ de'i 'og tu zla ba bcu'i mthar rtsa ba'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i dam tshig rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin yang dag par bstan pa'i rigs pas ma'i mngal nas thon par gyur te/ de'i dri za nye bar 'khor gyi sems can sha'i mig gi yul du gyur to/ /de ltar rtsa ba'i rgyud las gsungs te/

bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi sems rdo rje zhal gsum pa lta bur de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yang dag par gzigs par gyur to/ /zhes so/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /'dir gsungs pa'i dri za ni sngar gyi bar srid kyi rgyun yin pas dri za ste bar srid kyi ming btags pa tsam yin la mtshan nyid pa ni ma yin te/ mngal du nying mtshams sbyar tshun chad nas skye srid kyi skabs yin pas so/ /bcom ldan 'das zhes sogs kyi don ni mngal du yan lag dod pa sogs lus grub pa sbyang gzhir byas nas de sbyong byed byang chub kyi sems rdo rje ste dang po'i mgon po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa de yin zhing / mngal nas phyir btsas pa de sbyang gzhir byas nas de sbyong byed du lus dkyil bkod la de'i rkyen gyis dang po'i mgon po de sprul sku rdor sems zhal gsum phyag drug par gyur pa de yin te/ de ltar du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis yang dag par gzigs so zhes 'chad dgos pa yin no/ /mdo bsre ltar dang po'i mgon po'i rten la lus dkyil bkod pa ni skra dang sen mo sogs mngal gyi nang du 'phel ba dang chos mthun par rang lugs kyi mkhas pa phyi ma dag bzhed do/ /lus dkyil gyi skabs 'di bshad gzhi dang dogs dpyod rgya che yang rang lugs kyi bde kye sogs kyi rnam bshad so so na rgyas par yod pas 'dir ma bkod do/ /bzhi pa rnal 'byor chen po ni/ mdor byas las/ sbyor ba chen po yang dag brtsams/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan/ de la gsum/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa/ sems dpa' gsum brtsegs su bsgom pa/ rigs bdag gi dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi gnas gsum du yig 'bru dkar dmar mthing gsum gnas pa'i oṃ las spyan ma'i tshogs spros/ de dag gis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rnam snang yab yum dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/

dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyis gsol ba btab pas rnam snang yab yum spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam la smon lam tshigs bcad gcig btab la sku rdo rje'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i sngags brjod/ de bzhin du mgrin pa'i āḥdang snying kha'i hūm̐ gnyis la yang de ltar du rigs 'gre ste dkyus bzhin no/ /gnyis pa sems dpa' gsum brtsegs ni/ rang dam tshig sems dpar yun ring du bsam la snying ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las ye shes sems dpa' bsam/ de'i thugs kar ting 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ bsgom pa rnams sgrub thabs bzhin bya ste/ mdo bsrer/ de nas rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i ye shes sems dpa' rjes su bzhugs pas zhes pa nas/ snying po yi ge hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom mo/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gsum pa rigs bdag gi dbang bskur ba ni/ rang gi spyi bor rdo rje 'chang dkar po yab yum bsam pa snyoms 'jug byas pa'i byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi sbyor mtshams nas byung / spyi bo nas zhugs pas sems dpa' gsum bde ba chen pos mnyes shing tshim par bsam mo/ /de la sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprad na ma las btsas pa'i gzhon nu de'i lus ngag yid gsum rim gyis rgyas pa ni sbyang gzhi/ de dang chos mthun pa'i sbyong byed ni sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa de yin/ de bzhin du lus ngag yid gsum tshad du sleb nas bsam mno rdzogs pa ni sbyang gzhi/ sbyong byed ni sems dpa' gsum brtsegs su bsgom pa/ bsam mno rdzogs pa des mnga' thang la longs spyod pa ni sbyang gzhi/ sbyong byed ni rigs bdag gi phyag rgyas dbang bskur ba yin no/ /gsum pa rjes chags kyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ mdor byas las/ cho ga'i rim pa 'di yi ni/

/phyag rgya'i bsgrub pa brtsam par bya/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan/ 'di la gsum ste/ phyag rgya 'du bya ba/ rdo rje dang padma 'du bya ba/ snyoms 'jug byas te byang sems kyis de bzhin gshegs pa mchod nas nga rgyal bzung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ snying kha nas ye shes kyi phyag rgya phyung ste reg bya rdo rje mar bskyed/ de'i spyi bor lha rnams kyi sa bon oṃ la sogs pa bskyed pa dkyus bzhin bya/ gnyis pa ni/ hūm̐ dang āḥlas rdo rje dang padma bsgom mo/ /gsum pa ni/ snyoms 'jug byas pas rdo rje dang padma'i nang ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin 'od zer lngas gang bar bsam/ snyoms 'jug gi tshe rang nyid rin 'byung du bsgom ste snyoms par 'jug pa ni/ tshor ba bde ba la longs spyod pa'i skabs yin zhing / rin 'byung ni tshor ba'i ngo bo yin pas so/ /de nas rdo rje 'chang du dmigs pa go 'pho ste/ lha de bde ba la longs spyod pa'i bdag po yin pas so/ /de nas don grub tu bsam nas phung khams skye mched kyi cha shas zhu ba'i dwangs ma byang chub kyi sems kyis lus dkyil gyi lha rnams mchod pa yin te/ don yod grub pa ni mchod pa'i lha yin pas so/ /de ltar phyag rgya 'du bya bas ni rigs kyi bu mo bag mar len pa sbyong / rdo rje dang padma 'du bya bas ni pho'i rdo rje dang mo'i padma rgyas pa sbyong / snyoms 'jug byed pas ni pho mo nyal po byed pa sbyong zhing mtshon par yang nus so/ /de yan chad ni rang don phun sum tshogs pa chos sku lam du byed pa'i sgrub thabs yin te/ mdo bsre las/ bdag gi don phun sum tshogs pa dang po'i sbyor ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin bstan to/ /zhes gsungs/ 'dir sgrub thabs dngos grub rgya mtsho las/ thun 'og ma gsum la sngar bzhin rgyas par bsgom pa'am/ de tsam mi nus na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang / tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas srung 'khor nas rjes chags kyi spyod pa yan chad dang po sbyor ba rdzogs par bsgom la/

de'i mthar bzlas pa dang mchod bstod nyer bsdu sogs bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas bsnyen pa'i skabs sam skabs gzhan du yang rung rgyas bsdus kyi rnam gzhag de ltar shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ni/ mdor byas las/ rang sngags yi ge las byung ba/ /rdo rje gsum gyi byin rlabs bdag /ces pa nas/ lha ni sum cu gnyis rang bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad bskyed nas ni/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ 'di la gsum ste/ snyoms 'jug bya ba/ mngal du rten dang brten pa bskyed pa/ de phyir spro ba'o/ /dang po ni/ slar yang snyoms 'jug byas te dga' ba'i sgras phyi nas spyan drangs pa'i dkyil 'khor spyi gtsug nas zhugs te zhu ba dang / rang gi lus dkyil gyi phung khams skye mched kyi cha shas zhu ba'i thig le gnyis yum gyi padmar babs pa cha gnyis su gyur par bsam/ gnyis pa ni/ thig le cha gcig las bhruṃ las gzhal yas khang gdan bcas bskyed/ cha gcig cha so gnyis su gyur nas so so'i gdan gyi steng du 'khod pa las lha rnams bskyed de/ de yang thig le so so lha rang rang gi sa bon 'bru gsum gyis spel ba las rang rang gi phyag mtshan du gyur pa las lha de dang de zhal phyag rdzogs par bskyed pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ mi bskyod pa la sogs pa lha re re bzhin yum gyi mkha' nang nas yab kyi thugs kar drangs/ thugs kha nas so so'i 'byin sngags kyis phyir spros/ nam mkha' khyab par gyur pas rang rang gi mdzad pa mdzad/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu bsdus sprul gzhi'i ye shes pa dang 'dres pa la rang gi rigs bdag yab yum gyi byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang bskur te phyi'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du mi bskyod pa dbus kyi mi bskyod pa la thim/ 'khor rnams so so'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mkha' nang gi gzhal yas khang spros/ snod kyi dri ma sbyangs/ slar 'dus/ phyi'i gzhal yas khang la thim par bsam la rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor snang la rang bzhin med pa stong pa nyid dang gsal ba zung du 'jug pa'i rang bzhin du bsams te yun ring du gsal btab cing bsgom mo/

/dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog 'dis ni pho mo 'dus pa las bu dang bu mo mang po spel ba de sbyong bar byed do/ /de dag ni longs sku lam byed kyi ting nge 'dzin no/ /gsum pa sprul sku lam du byed pa las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin la brgyad de/ phra mo'i rnal 'byor/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ ngag gi bzlas pa/ gtso bo don dam du bzhugs pa/ yum bzhis bskul te bzhengs pa/ de la bstod cing mchod pa/ nye bar bsdu ba/ las kyi rab tu dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ mdor byas las/ de nas phra mo'i rnal 'byor brtsams/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan/ 'di la rnam rtog shas che bas steng sgo la brten pa'i phra mo dang / 'dod chags shas che bas 'og sgo la brten pa'i phra mo'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa gnyis yod do/ /gnyis pa rdor bzlas ni/ mdo bsrer/ le'u bcu bdun pa las/ slong mo bza' zhing mi bzlas te/ /zhes sogs drangs nas/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa bstan par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas bstan/ de dag gi don ni sgron gsal du 'byung gsungs/ gsum pa ngag bzlas ni/ mdo bsrer le'u gsum pa las/ brjod nas rdo rje spro ba ni/ /zhes sogs rkang pa drug drangs nas sngags so so bzlas pa'i tshe lha so so'i sku dpag tu med pa spros nas sems can gyi don byas zhes gsungs pas bstan/ nyams len ni dkyus na gsal lo/ /bzhi pa gtso bo don dam du bzhugs pa ni/ mdor byas las/ slar yang sngags pas bdag nyid ni/ /de bzhin nyid la bzhugs par bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ don ni dkyus bzhin no/ /lnga pa glus bskul ba ni/ mdor byas las/ de nas dkyil 'khor gnas pa yi/ /lha mos bdag po ma mthong nas/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'di bzhi yis/ /zhes pa nas/ brjod pas mgon po de bskul bas/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ tshigs bcad rnams ni dkyus na gsal lo/ /drug pa bstod cing mchod pa ni/ mdo bsrer/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i bstod pa rnams kyis yang dag par bstod par byas te zhes dang /

cho ga bzhin legs par mchod nas zhes pas bstan/ nyams len ni dkyus bzhin/ bdun pa nyer bsdu ni/ mdo bsrer/ rang gi lus la gzhug par bya'o/ /zhes pa nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin du bsam la nye bar bsdu bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas bstan/ brgyad pa las kyi rab tu dbye ba ni/ mdor byas las/ sngags pas ting 'dzin dmigs pa yi/ /gang tshe lus ni bsgom gyur te/ /zhes pa la sogs pas lus rgyas pa'i cho ga dang / mdo bsrer/ las kyi dbye ba rnams kyang bya'o/ /rim pa 'di nyid le'u bcu bdun pa las/ sku rdo rje'i kha zas dang / zhes sogs drangs pas lus 'tsho ba'i kha zas kyi rnal 'byor bstan/ de ltar na las rgyal mchog ni bu dang bu mo mang po spel ba'i rigs rgyud rnams kyis bya ba'i las sna tshogs byed pa dang chos mthun zhing / de dag gi sbyong byed yin no/ /rnal 'byor bla med kyi lugs la spang gnyen ro gcig pa'i phyir na sbyang gzhi dang 'dra ba'i sbyong byed gnyen po de dang de rang rang gi sbyang gzhi dang chos mthun zhing / de'i sbyong byed du mchog tu bsngags pa ni lam zab pa yin te/ log gnon gyi gnyen po yin pas so/ /de skad du brtag gnyis las/ bzlog pa'i bsgom pa 'di nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas mu stegs kyis mi shes/ /zhes dang / skye bo mi zad pa yi las/ /gang dang gang gis 'ching gyur pa/ /thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyis/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa rjes lam gyi yan lag ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ces sogs kyi smon lam rnam par dag pas rgyas btab/ gtor chog nas 'byung ba bzhin 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha tshogs rnams la gtor ma phul la 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ bkra shis kyi phreng bas mtha' brten par bya'o/ /sa skya'i 'jam mgon zhal gyi 'od dkar las/ /rmongs pa'i mun pa drungs nas 'byin pa bzhin/

/bskyed rim 'od kyi snang ba lham mer gsal/ /legs byas dbyangs bdun rol mo 'di na khrol/ /de dag ni dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi chos skor gyi rim pa las bskyed rim gyis zin thun snying por dril ba blo gsal bde 'jug ces bya ba ste rim par phye ba gnyis pa'o// ༈ //ngag gi dbang phyug 'gro kun dga' ba'i gnyen/ /bsod nams gzi byin grags pa'i 'od dkar gsal/ /rgyal ba'i mtshan dpe dpal rgyun bzang po'i gter/ /g.yo med skye dgu'i mgon du brtan bzhugs gsol/ /ngag dbang 'jam pa'i rdo rje kun dga'i skyes/ /bsod nams mchog gi rtser son grags pa'i tog /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mngon mtho'i dpal bzang po/ /bskal brgyar zhabs brtan 'gro kun shis pas skyongs/ /gang gi gsung gi gsang ba chos kyi mdzod/ /nam mkha'i dbyings bzhin mtha' dang mu bral ba/ /gsang chen chos kyi gan mdzod zad mi shes/ /rim lnga'i legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba spel/ /gsum pa skabs don rim lnga bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis te/ rim lnga spyi'i rnam gzhag mdor bstan pa dang / nyams len khrid kyi rim pa rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ chos 'di'i rten gzhir gyur pa'i rgyud la rtsa rgyud dang bshad rgyud gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud 'di'i le'u bcu bdun pa yan ni rtsa rgyud rkyang pa yin/ slob dpon zla ba grags pas kyang 'di yan la 'grel pa mdzad/ le'u bco brgyad pa rgyud phyi mar grags pa ni le'u snga ma rnams la 'phros nas dri lan lnga bcu nga bzhi la sogs pa'i sgo nas sngar gyi don gsal bar byed pas na le'u bcu bdun pa yan gyi bshad rgyud yin zhing / spyir ni rang gi ngo bo rtsa rgyud du gzhag par bya ste/ dper na kyai rdor rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis kyi brtag pa phyi ma de brtag pa dang po'i bshad rgyud yin kyang / rang gi ngo bo rtsa rgyud du 'jog pa bzhin no/

/'di 'dra'i rigs can gzhan yang yod de/ gnad 'di kun gyis rtogs par bya'o/ /bshad rgyud la thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud gnyis dang / thun mong ba'i bshad rgyud gnyis te bzhi yod de/ lha mo bzhis zhus pas gtso bor rdzogs rim bstan cing rgyud gzhan dang thun mong ba yin/ rdo rje phreng bas dbang chog phal che ba dang / bskyed rim ting 'dzin gsum gyi 'ching / rdzogs rim rim lnga'i rnam gzhag dkyil 'khor gyi lha grangs sum cu so gnyis su byed pa sogs ni gsang ba 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud du 'gro zhing / gzhan bde mchog sogs la phan pa yang mang du yod 'dug thun mong ma yin pa dgongs pa lung ston gyi rtsa rgyud kyi stod kyi tshig re re yang mtha' drug tshul bzhir 'chad pa bstan/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pas 'chad thabs rgyan bdun la sogs pa bstan/ de ltar na rtsa rgyud gcig dang bshad rgyud bzhi las lngar rnam par gzhag go /rgyud de gang la 'chad pa'i slob ma ni 'di pa'i lugs kyis lngar 'chad de/ stong thun du lung drangs pa las/ blo yi rnam pa dpag med las/ /gang zag rnam pa lngar 'dod do/ /utpa la dang pad dkar dang / /padma tsandan rin chen no/ /utpa la lta bu/ padma dkar po lta bu/ padma dmar po lta bu/ tsandan lta bu/ rin po che lta bu'i gang zag dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ thos pa che ba/ don zin pa/ de ma thag tshig don gnyis ka brjed par 'gyur ba ste khyad chos gsum ldan no/ /gnyis pa ni snga ma gnyis dang / tshig don gzhan la ston mi nus pa dang bcas pas chos gsum ldan no/ /gsum pa ni/ dad pa che ba/ snying rje che ba/ thos pa che ba/ de ma thag tshig don brjed par 'gyur ba ste chos bzhi ldan no/ /bzhi pa ni/ thos pa chung ba/ nga rgyal che ba/ don gyi rtsa ba med pa/ tshul khrims/ tshig gi spros pa mang ba/ don gzhan gyis zin par mi nus pa ste khyad chos lnga ldan no/ /lnga pa ni tshul khrims dag pa/

mkhas pa/ bsgrin pa ste khong grung ba/ thos pa che ba/ shes rab che ba/ rgyud gzhan du mi 'gyur ba/ don gzhan la ston nus pa ste khyad chos bdun ldan no/ /de ltar lnga las dang po bzhi ni tshogs bshad bya ba'i yul yin te/ utpa la dang pad dkar dang / padma tsandan nyid dag ste/ /gang zag bzhi po 'di dag ni/ /tshogs la bshad pa'i gang zag go /de dag gis rang gis nyan pa dang sgrub pa nyams len byar rung gi gdul bya gzhan gtso bor rjes su 'dzin mi nus pas so/ /lnga pa ni slob bshad bya ba'i yul yin te/ rdzogs pa'i rim pas skal ldan zhing / /rtag tu spyod pas rnam brgyan pa/ 'di ni rin chen gang zag ste/ /slob ma la bshad snod yin no/ /des gdul bya gzhan rjes su 'dzin nus pas so/ /slob ma mchog de la ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul ni/ rim pa lnga'am dgu'i sgo nas 'chad par byed de/ rim pa lnga la slob dpon zla bas bskyed rim la rim pa gcig dben gsum la sems tsam la dmigs pa zhes pa'i rim pa gcig dang / rim pa gsum pa kun rdzob bden pa sgyu lus/ bzhi pa kun rdzob bden pa dag pa'i don dam 'od gsal/ lnga pa bden gnyis zung du sbyor ba ste zung 'jug dang lnga la rim pa lngar mdzad nas rgyud kyi don ma lus pa rim pa lnga po der 'dus par gsungs te/ sgron gsal du/ gsang sngags sku ni rab sgrub byed/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa dang po yin/ /sems la dmigs pa tsam zhig ni/ /rim pa gnyis pa zhes brjod do/ /kun rdzob bden pa bstan pa ni/ /yid 'ong rim pa gsum pa yin/ /kun rdzob bden pa dag pa ni/ /rim pa bzhi pa zhes brjod de/ /bden gnyis sbyor ba gang yin pa'i/ /zung 'jug ces bya lnga pa ste/ /'di ni bsgrub pa'i man ngag mchog /rgyud kun gyi ni don bsdus pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /slob dpon 'phags pa nyid kyis bskyed rim la sgrub thabs mdor byas dang mdo bsre logs su byas nas de sngon song gi rdzogs rim la rim pa lngar mdzad de/

rim lnga'i gzhung gi dbu nyid du/ rnal 'byor rgyud pha rgyud/ kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /rdo rje bzlas pa'i rim bshad bya/ /bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas shing / /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams la/ /thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /skas kyi rim pa lta bur gsungs/ /sems can rnams kyi srog gyur pa/ /rlung zhes bya ba las kun byed/ /ces gsungs pas ngag dben rlung gi rnal 'byor ni rim pa dang po/ sems dben rim pa gnyis pa/ kun rdzob sgyu lus bdag byin gyis brlabs pa ni gsum pa/ mngon par byang chub pa ste don dam 'od gsal ni bzhi pa/ bden gnyis zung 'jug ni lnga pa yin par rim lnga'i gzhung las gsungs so/ /'o na lus dben gang du bsdu zhe na/ snga rabs pa rnams 'di bskyed rim gyis zab shos dang / rdzogs rim gyi mi zab shos yin pas bskyed rdzogs ri thang mtshams pa yin no gsungs pa la/ kun mkhyen bla ma bsod nams seng ges/ 'di ni mi rigs te/ 'di la sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyar ba'i lha'i rnam pa bsgom pa tsam las rlung gi rnal 'byor sogs med pa'i phyir na rang gi ngo bo bskyed rim gyi lam gyi phyogs yin la/ 'on kyang 'di ngag dben bsgom pa'i sngon 'gro yin pas/ bsdu na rdzogs rim gyi khongs su bsdu ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di gnad kyi don phul du phyin pa yin no/ /yang slob dpon 'phags pa lhas/ lam gyi rim pa yongs rdzogs kyi dbang du byas nas rim pa dgur mdzad de/ sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa'i bsam pa la bslab pa/ theg pa gsar gsang ba 'dus pa 'di 'das pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad la sogs pas ma gsungs shing / 'o skol gyi ston pa 'dis gsar du gsungs pas na theg pa gsar pa zhes bya ba yin/ pa'i dran pa gcig pa'i rnal 'byor la bslab pa/ rtog pa'i rnal 'byor la bslab pa/ rigs kyi dbye bas lus rnam par dben pa la bslab pa/

a l̥ ka l̥'i bdag nyid ngag rnam par dben pa la bslab pa/ thams cad rnam par dag pa sems rnam par dben pa la bslab pa/ sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyis mtshon pa'i kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu la bslab pa/ ril 'dzin dang rjes bzhig gi rnam pas don dam 'od gsal la bslab pa/ mthar bden gnyis zung 'jug la bslab pa dang dgu las/ dang po ni skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed kyis rgyud sbyangs te dbang bskur ba'i snod rung du byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni dbang bskur te dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sam dpa' bo gcig pa'i bskyed rim la dran pa rtse gcig pas bslab pa'o/ /gsum pa ni phra thig gi rnal 'byor la bslab pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni sbyang gzhi la rigs brgyar phye nas de sbyong byed kyi lha so gnyis kyang rigs brgyar phye ste bsgom/ de la goms pa na rigs lnga dang gsum du bsgom/ mthar gsang chen rigs gcig tu bsdus nas thugs rdo rje lta bu bsgom pa'o/ /lnga pa ni rlung 'jug gnas gsum rdo rje gsum gyi bzlas par ji srid ma shar gyi bar du bsgom pa'o/ /drug pa ni snang mched thob gsum gyi rim pas gnyis snang gi rtog pa rags pa ma dag gi bar du bsgom pa'o/ /bdun pa ni dben gsum gyi bsgrub pa'i rdo rje gsum po de mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku sgyu ma lta bur bsgrub pa'o/ /brgyad pa ni bden 'dzin gyi dri ma sbyong ba'i phyir sku de yang 'od gsal stong nyid du sbyong ba'o/ /dgu pa ni de ltar 'od gsal stong pa nyid las langs pa'i mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku de yang bden gnyis zung 'jug gi ngo bo can du byed pa'o/ /de ltar rim pa lnga la bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba dang / rim pa dgur phye ba rnams ni lam gyi dbye bsdu tsam las 'gal ba med cing 'phags pa yab sras rnams dgongs pa gcig pa yin no/ /zhes stong thun las gsungs/ gnyis pa la don gsum ste/

sngon 'gro'i rnal 'byor gyis zung 'jug gi ye shes skye rung du bya ba/ dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor gyis zung 'jug gi ye shes bskyed pa/ rjes kyi rnal 'byor gyis nyams rtogs phyogs med du rtsal sbyang ba'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ mos gus skyed par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid/ tshogs rdzogs par byed pa phyag dang maṇḍal gyi khrid/ byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa mos gus gsol 'debs kyi khrid/ nyams grib dag par byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyi khrid do/ /dang po ni gnas bsam gtan gyi khang pa dben zhing nyams dga' bar stan bde ba la skyil krung du 'dug nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang 'dra bar byas la rang lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du dar sna tshogs kyi gdan dang / padma zla ba nyi ma rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa ste gdan drug bu ston gyi khrid yig na gdan gsum brtsegs las ma gsungs kyang / drug brtsegs 'di byang rtse'i khrid yig zin bris ma las bshad/ bu ston gyi gsung bgros yin pa'ang srid/ brtsegs kyi steng du rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo rnam pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ dbu skra mthon mthing thor cog spyi bor bcings pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum reg bya rdo rje ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis 'khor lo dang padma/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing / dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol ba/ ye shes sgyu ma lta bu'i sku mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba/ 'dir rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun zin bris las/ 'di nyid kyi rgyud gzhung las/

bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa gsal bar gsungs shing / khyad par rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun par/ bla ma byang chub kyi sems rdo rje bsgom tshul lung dang bcas pa gsungs/ byang chub sems rdo rje de'i mtshan nyid 'chad pa la/ rnam par snang mdzad 'dra ba'i mdog sogs drangs/ zhes gsungs pas dang po'i mgon po yin zhing / rim lnga las kyang de ltar gsungs la/ dang po'i mgon po yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas 'khyud pa re bsgom par rigs na/ bla ma rnams de ltar mdzad pa'i srol mi 'dug pas/ 'dir bla ma byang chub kyi sems rdo rje dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i rnam pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum dang bcas pa bsgom gsungs/ zhes 'byung / bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi gdan gyi skabs su dar glog stan zer yang gos 'bol yin gsungs/ drug brtsegs mdzad pa ni bu nyid kyis mdzad pa yin mod/ rin po che'i khri dang pad zla tsam gyis chog pa 'dra/ 'on kyang 'jam dpal seng ldan la 'jam dbyangs dar 'bol la bzhugs pa yang byas 'dug la/ bus kyang de gzigs pa yin pa 'dug rdo rje'i gdan ni 'dug pa'i lha la rang rigs kyi phyag mtshan gyi gdan bshad pa la dgongs nas byas pa yin gsungs/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang gi tshe 'di'i gsum ldan gyi bla ma la sogs pa mdor na tshe rabs thams cad du zhal mjal ba/ gsung thos pa/ byin gyis brlabs pa thams cad dang / de dag gi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang / sangs rgyas byang sems/ nyan rang chos skyong thams cad spyan drangs/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim bla ma'i rnal 'byor la khrom tshogs su bsgom pa/ mtho brtsegs su bsgom pa dang / gcig tu bsdus te bsgom pa dang lugs gsum las/ 'dir phyi ma'i dbang du byas pa yin/ pas bla ma de skyabs gnas kun 'dus su bsgom la mos gus dung dung pa rkang gi khong /

snying gi dkyil nas bya'o/ /de yang yon tan thams cad kyi rtsa ba bla ma'i mos gus yin te/ mos gus skyes na rgyud byin gyis brlabs te yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa skye bar bka' dang bstan bcos/ bla ma'i man ngag kun las bshad cing rnal 'byor pas nyams su myong bas kyang grub pa yin no/ /gnyis pa phyag dang maṇḍal gyi khrid ni/ de ltar mos gus bsgoms nas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /la sogs pas bstod cing phyag btsal/ snying kha nas mchod pa'i lha mo spros te mchod yon la sogs pas mchod par bsam la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta argham̐ pra titstsha pu tsa me gha nas/ shapta pra titstsha pu tsa sogs kyi bar brjod/ phyag len dkyus bzhin du maṇḍal tshom bu bdun ma tshar bdun la sogs pa 'bul/ de'i rjes su mos gus kyi gdung shugs bskyed la/ bla ma rin po che la/ mchod pa'i tshogs thams cad 'bul lo/ /sdig sgrib dang nyes ltung thams cad ni so sor bshags so/ /bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs la rjes su yi rangs so/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul lo/ /yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu btab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs rgyun bshags dang / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /zhes sogs rigs lnga'i sdom bzung lan gsum re bya/ gsum pa mos gus gsol 'debs kyi khrid ni/ sdom bzung tshar ba'i rjes su slar yang mos gus kyis gdung shugs tshad med pa bskyed de/ bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las rnams gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/

/thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su gzung ba dang / byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral du gsol/ thar pa bla na med pa'i go 'phang myur du thob par mdzad du gsol/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ bla ma'i spyi bo'i oṃ dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ bdag gi spyi bor thim pas bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag de bzhin du mgrin pa'i āḥdamar po dang / thugs kha'i hūm̐ sngon po las 'od 'phros pas gsang dbang dang sher dbang thob tshul yang rigs 'gre /yang bla ma'i sku'i cha shas thams cad las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa 'phros/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ rkang mthil yan chad gang bas dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum ka'i chags pa'i sgrib pa dang shes sgrib dag par bsam/ spyi bo'i bla ma yab yum 'od phung bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du zhu ste bdag gi spyi gtsug nas thim pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang / bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du 'dres par bsam la de'i ngang la bzo med du lhod kyis bzhag de ltar thun bzhi'i rim pas zhag grangs ci rigs par nyams su blang bar bya ste/ sngon 'gro bla ma'i rnal 'byor la nan tan du ma byas na dngos gzhi'i skabs su yon tan ye mi skye bar bla ma kun mgrin gcig tu gsungs/ bzhi pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyi khrid ni/ rang gi spyi bor sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/

ral pa'i thor cog can/ zhi zhing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan la sogs pa/ rgyan brgyad kyis spras shing / sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ yab kyi thugs khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs pa nas sdig sgrib phyir 'thon pa'i bar bla med spyi'i lugs bzhin du bsam la/ oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya zhes sogs rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya thun re la brgya rtsa la sogs pa'am/ ji ltar mtha' na'ang nyer gcig re bzlas la/ phyag 'tshal bstod cing phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyag 'tshal 'dud de phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gus pas gus la bdag gsol 'debs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag sgrubs shig /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang zhes sogs dkyus bzhin gsol ba btab pas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam la bde stong spros pa med pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /de yang sbyang gzhi'i dpe la sbyang bya'i sdig sgrib zer ba snang ngo /sdig sgrib/ sbyong byed kyi thabs/ sbyong byed kyi sgrub pa po gsum ka rang gi sems kyi cho 'phrul ma gtogs bden par grub pa ci yang med pas bden med kyi lta bas rgyas btab na sdig sbyong gi mchog yin te/ rgyud las/ drang por 'dug la yang dag ltos/ /'gyod tshangs rnams kyi mchog yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de rnams thams cad sems gzhan du ma yengs par/ dmigs pa'i steng du khrig khrig 'gro ba gcig byung na rang rgyud la byin rlabs shig 'jug nges yin/ sngon 'gro 'di rnams zhag grangs ci rigs par thun bzhi'i rim pas nyams su blang ba gal che/ chos zab mo 'di lta bu la las sla dang mgyogs chos sogs mi bya bar rgyud la smin nges rang byas na phan thogs pa yin no/

/gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor gyi zung 'jug gi ye shes bskyed pa la lnga ste/ rdo rje bzlas pa'i rim pa/ sems dben gyi rim pa/ kun rdzob bden pa sgyu lus kyi rim pa/ don dam bden pa 'od gsal gyi rim pa/ bden gnyis zung 'jug gi rim pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ sngon 'gro lus dben dang / dngos gzhi ngag dben no/ /dang po ni/ lus dben gyi sngon du yang bskyed rim bsgom par gsungs pas/ mngon shes can gyi gdams pa las/ dang po sbyor ba dkyil 'khor dang / /las rgyal mchog dang dran pa gcig /yang dang yang du bsgom pa yi/ /reg mthong rtags gnyis byung byung bsgom/ /phra mo'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa yi/ /steng sgo 'og sgo la brten gnyis/ /rlung shas che na 'og sgo bsgom/ /mkhris pa shas che gnyis ka bsgom/ /thig le yig 'bru phyag mtshan dang / /lha sku bsgoms te spro bsdu bya/ /zhes bshad/ de la gnyis te/ dran pa gcig pa'i kye rdor du dran pa gcig pa dpa' gcig la byed pa yod kyang / 'di pas dran pa gcig pa dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sam dpa' bo gcig pa gang la dran pa rtse gcig tu gnas pa la dran pa gcig par byed/ rnal 'byor dang / phra thig gi rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po ni/ /ting 'dzin gsum gyi chings dang ldan pa'i mngon rtogs sgrub thabs ltar bsgom nas sems 'dzin/ de yang dang po gtso bo la sems 'dzin/ de la sems brtan na rnam snang nas gnod mdzes kyi bar la lha re re nas sems 'dzin/ de nas gzhal yas khang la/ de nas snod bcud thams cad lhar ma shar gyi bar bsgom/ de ltar bsgoms pas rnam rtog gi g.yeng bas bsgul mi nus par sems bskyed rim gyi ngang la rtse gcig tu gnas na dran pa gcig pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ste/ reg mthong gi mtshan ma ma byung gi bar du bsgom par yang gsungs/ gnyis pa ni dran pa gcig pa'i rnal 'byor la brtan pa thob pa dang /

rang nyid gtso bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs zhu ba las byung ba'i byang chub sems kyi thig le yungs 'bru'i tshad tsam bsam/ de'i nang du bcud kyi sems can thams cad gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs dang / snod kyi 'jig rten rnams gzhal yas khang du bsgom zhing / brtan pa thob nas 'og nas 'byung ba ltar spro zhing bsdu/ yang na kun rdzob kyi sna rtser thig le yungs 'bru tsam gyi nang du rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gcig car gsal btab la bsgom/ de la brtan pa thob nas spro zhing bsdu/ dmigs pa de gnyis ni gcig car lha bsgom pa'i phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro/ /yang rang gtso bor gsal ba'i rtsa zhal gyi sna rtser zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sran ma phyed pa tsam gyi steng du rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa yungs 'bru tsam bsgom/ de la brtan pa thob pa dang de las phyag mtshan gnyis pa spro/ yang de las gsum pa la sogs pa nam mkha'i khams khyab pa'i bar du spro zhing slar gcig tu bsdu/ /de la brtan pa thob nas phyag mtshan de lha skur bsgyur te zhal phyag rnams gsal btab la bsgom/ de la brtan pa thob nas 'og ltar spro zhing bsdu/ de la brtan pa thob nas de'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor sprul pa'i spro bsdu la bslabs te dmigs pa 'di gsum ni rnam rtog shas che bas bsgom bya steng sgo la brten pa'i rnal 'byor yin/ gang zag gi blo'i 'jug pas dmigs pa gsum ka bsgom pa'am/ gang rung re bsgoms kyang chog te/ sems kyi rnam tog khegs na dmigs pa gcig gis kyang don tshang ngo / /yang rang gi rdo rjer thig le yungs 'bru tsam sngon po gsal zhing dwangs pa mi bskyod pa'i ngo bor bsgom/ de la brtan pa thob nas rdo rje dang padma 'du bya ba sngon du 'gro bas snyoms 'jug byas la de yum gyi padmar spro/ de nas thig le de mi bskyod pas gtso byas pa'i dkyil 'khor du bskyed nas phyir spro ba bu'i tshul du spro ba dang /

thig le las bskyed pa'i mi bskyod pa des kyang snyoms 'jug sngon du 'gro ba ni tsha bo'i tshul du spro ba zhes kyang bya/ slar tshur 'dus te spro gzhi'i lha la thim par bsam/ 'di ni nyon mongs pa chags pa shas che bas bsgom bya 'og sgo la brten pa'i thig le phra mo la bslab pa ste rim gyis lha bskyed phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro/ /'di rnams mngon shes can gyi gdams pa gtso che/ ni ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi sgrub thabs nas gsungs pa yin zhing / ming gi rnam grangs la rtog rtog pa'i sgra don ni dmigs pa phra ba gcig la 'jog par bshad/ pa'i rnal 'byor dang / phra mo'i rnal 'byor dang / phra thig gi rnal 'byor zhes bya ste/ btsun mo can gyi gdams pa las kyang / snod bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / bcud bskyed pa'i rim pa ltar bskyed nas dran pa gcig pa'i lha'i rnam pa la dmigs pa'i sgo nas sems sbyang ba dang / de nas phra thig gi sbyang ba dang / de nas las dang po pa la gnas pa'i bar ni gzhung las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin bslab par bya zhes gsungs pas so/ /lus dben dngos la bsgom pa'i rten gyi gang zag sogs don tshan bdun las/ dang po ni/ bskyed rim rags pa mthar phyin bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas shing / /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams la/ /thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /skas kyi rim pa lta bur gsungs/ /nas mchog gi dngos grub don du gnyer bas lus dben nas bzung gtso bor rdzogs rim bsgom par 'dod pa'o/ /gnyis pa shes bya ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ sku yi rdo rje rdzogs byang chub/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam spyad pa/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bsgom pa'i tshe lus thams cad don dam par stong pa nyid las byung zhing / stong pa nyid la thim pas nam mkha' dang 'dra ba yin la/ kun rdzob tu dngos po brgyas bsdus pa'i lus thams cad sangs rgyas lnga'i rdul phra rab las grub par shes par bya'o/
